datasets_used: CMS Medicare Part D Spending by Drug PUF (CY2023 annual)
NHS Drug Tariff Part VIIIA April 2026
CMS IRA Round 1/2/3 fact sheets (exclusion lists + MFPs)

gotchas_confirmed.partd_overall_row_dedup: HONORED. PUF carries an Mftr_Name=='Overall' row AND per-manufacturer rows per drug. Summing all rows double-counts (Eliquis $36.5B vs true $18.3B). Filtered to Overall before aggregation.
gotchas_confirmed.partd_gross_vs_net: HONORED (Stage 5.5 Challenge 1 net-to-net correction). PUF is GROSS. Tiered rebate (0.49 top / 0.275 mid / 0.20 biologic / 0.70 insulin) applied ONCE to convert gross->net; RAND's rebate-adjusted NET ratio 3.22x (net gap 0.689) is then applied to the net base. Rebate appears exactly once; net price gap applied to net dollars (internally consistent). Prior central applied the 4.22x GROSS gap (0.763) to a net base (inconsistent, +~11%); now retained only as an upper-method sensitivity.
gotchas_confirmed.insulin_rebate_repair: HONORED (2026-06-08). Insulin SKUs (glargine/lispro/aspart/degludec/detemir) moved to a single 0.70 rebate tier (ASPE HP-2022-22 + SSR Health: insulin gross-to-net 65-84%). Fixes the Lantus Solostar 0.49 vs sibling-SKU 0.20 inconsistency; reduces insulin savings.
gotchas_confirmed.rand_brand_only_ratio: HONORED. RAND RR-A788-3 brand-name originator ratios: 4.22x GROSS, 3.22x rebate-adjusted NET (NOT the 2.78x all-drugs ratio). The CENTRAL now uses the 3.22x NET ratio applied to the net spend base (net-to-net, Challenge 1). The 4.22x gross ratio is retained as an upper-method sensitivity. Brand-only ratio applied to a brand-only universe.
gotchas_confirmed.multisource_brand_leak: HONORED (Stage 5.5 Challenge 3). Dropped distinct-trade-name brands with US generic/biosimilar competition by CY2023 (Symbicort, Restasis, Advair Diskus/HFA, Vascepa, Flovent HFA, Copaxone + audit additions Latuda, Multaq) that the programmatic screens could not catch; backfilled to 100.
gotchas_confirmed.residual_pool_selection_caveat: DISCLOSED (Stage 5.5 Challenge 2). Universe excludes the highest-gap off-patent-abroad blockbusters (sent to IRA); the on-patent biologic/specialty residual's true US-vs-OECD ratio may sit below the 3.22 net average, so the central may be overstated. Named downward-uncertainty limitation; per-drug intl prices are the data-partner CTA.
gotchas_confirmed.issue7_glp1_overlap: HONORED. Tirzepatide (Mounjaro/Zepbound) excluded on Issue #7 GLP-1 overlap basis (ROADMAP rule #5); not an IRA selection, so added explicitly to the exclusion list. Liraglutide (Victoza) reviewed and kept (not in Issue #7's booked scope).
gotchas_confirmed.generic_leak_filter: HONORED. Multi-source/authorized-generic rows that leaked the naive brand flag (CMS '*' flag, punctuation variants, AG distributors Prasco/Cipla/Aurobindo/Amneal/Upsher-Smith) removed; brand flag tightened; universe backfilled to 100 single-source brands.
gotchas_confirmed.vaccines_excluded: HONORED. RSV/shingles vaccines (Arexvy/Shingrix/Abrysvo) excluded; vaccine international pricing is tender-based, RAND therapeutic-brand ratio a poor fit (Stage 3 Counter 6 / Red-Team flag #4).
gotchas_confirmed.no_days_supply_field: HONORED. PUF has no Tot_Day_Suply; per-30-day not computable. Used Avg_Spnd_Per_Dsg_Unt_Wghtd (per dosage unit) for the scale-invariant ratio.
gotchas_confirmed.ira_match_brand_and_generic: HONORED. Semaglutide (Ozempic/Rybelsus/Wegovy) and all IRA R1/2/3 drugs excluded by brand+generic substring match.
gotchas_confirmed.nhs_off_patent_floor: HONORED. NHS Drug Tariff = off-patent UK generic price; used only as an illustrative gap and an upper-bound floor, NOT as the headline reference.
gotchas_confirmed.exchange_rate_gbp_usd: GBP/USD=1.3; headline is RAND-based so insensitive to this rate (NHS gaps only).

originality_posture: Headline computed from CMS Part D PUF top-100 brands minus IRA R1+2+3, RAND OECD-33 brand reference, tiered rebate, recoverability. Distinguished from curated RAND/IRA inputs.
